description: Focused 120-second elapsed no-fire mixed encounters. Excluded from the primary three-seed table. Two seconds of recording pre-roll before the roster permits padding for initial turns. Primary player input driver and AI/movement methods unchanged. The clear passes hide only rendered combat dust and grenade plumes and choose a spectator bearing using actor bounds; they do not alter inputs, AI, collision or snapshots. Non-focused cloaker observations in these supplemental runs are unclassified and are not pooled into the primary cloaker comparison.
